3. Material — Suitable steels meeting the requirements laid down in 4. 

Example: ■ 

Steel designation 40C8 or 45C8 conforming to IS : 1570 ( Part 2 )-1 979 'Schedules for 
wrought steels: Part 2 Carbon steels ( unalloyed steels ) ( first revision )\

5. Designation — Conveyor belt-fastener spanner shall be designated by its commonly used name, 
belt-fasteners designation for which it is used and the number of this standard. 

Example: 

Spanner used for conveyor belt-fastener designation 53 shall be designated as: 
Belt-Fastener Spanner 53 IS : 12403. 

6. Tommy Bars — The spanner shall be provided with a hole ( Dia D ) for tommy bar as shown in 2. 
The tommy bar shall conform to IS : 6002-1971 'Specification for tommy bars for box spanners'. 

6.1 The tommy bars shall be a separate item and shall not be supplied with the spanner unless 
specifically ordered. 

7. Workmanship and Finish, Preservation and Packing, Sampling — Shall be in accordance 
with IS : 6131-1980 'Technical requirements for hand operated wrenches (spanners) and sockets 
(first revision )'. 

8. Marking — Spanners shall be legibly and indelibly marked with belt fastener's designation, 
manufacturer's name, initials or recognized trade- mark, if any. 

8.1 Standard Marking ~- Details available with the Bureau of Indian Standards. 



EX P L A N A TO R Y N OT E 

These are special purpose spanners used for tightening or loosening of screws and nuts of 
conveyor belt-fasteners conforming to IS : 10288-1982 for joining two ends of the conveyor belts. 

While preparing this specification, considerable assistance has been taken from the data supplied 
by the users and manufacturers of this product. 



Printed at Printrade, New Delhi, India
